WARN: BOTH ARE OUT-OF-BAND, ACCOUNT-LEVEL EVENTS WITH NO DEPLOY AND NO CODE REVIEW ATTACHED -- sms.ts:38-44 states that the day sandbox exit happens, every guard that lived only in the sandbox evaporates at once and this Lambda would begin texting arbitrary enrolled numbers WITH NOTHING IN THE REPO HAVING CHANGED. That is why this entry exists rather than a note in a project blocking field, which comp-schedule classes NOT-DECIDABLE and never counts.
